title: The Dip at Rush Hour

objectives.text: Catch the pickpocket in the crowd

traversal.at: the rush-hour platform, shoulder to shoulder
up the stairs against the crowd coming down
back over the exit turnstiles (heat only if a transit cop sees)

objectives.traversalMobile: One context button (climb/vault/tackle), auto-aligned. No precise timing. The quarry rubber-bands (never more than ~40 m ahead), so no timer fails the player.

rewards.text: A tip, or keep the wallet (+1 heat if a witness saw)
rewards.payNote: The commuter's tip; keep the wallet instead for about $60 and +1 heat if seen.

mobile: Generous catch distance; no platform-edge hazards during the chase.
